purpose: Specialist melody/bass paths (ANALYSIS ENGINE stream G, PR-88): 4-stem separation followed by monophonic pitch tracking on one stem. Returns raw evidence (frames and events); note segmentation, fusion and scoring live in artifacts/api-server/src/lib/melodyBassPaths.ts.

separation.family: Hybrid Transformer Demucs v4 (Meta, MIT licence)
separation.note: demucs itself verifies only the first 8 hex characters of the sha256 (the file-name suffix); this worker verifies the full digest at build and on every /health.

crepe.implementation: torchcrepe (CREPE, Kim et al. 2018; PyTorch port by Max Morrison, MIT licence)

basic_pitch.implementation: Spotify Basic Pitch 0.4.0 (Apache-2.0), ONNX Runtime backend
basic_pitch.note: The same ICASSP-2022 checkpoint the live music-ai-worker attests; here it is run on a separated stem with register limits and its thresholds exposed.

licence_position: All components are permissively licensed (MIT / Apache-2.0). This is an analysis worker: nothing here generates music and nothing here is a product route; it exists so a melody or bass line can be measured before it is trusted.
